tasks.prompt: Fix Requests issue #6992 in src/requests/models.py at requests.models.PreparedRequest.prepare_body. tasks.prompt: Add an explicit zero-length stream framing extension in src/requests/models.py at requests.models.PreparedRequest.prepare_body.
